title: Ministries/Departments of Government of India geared up for implementation phase of Special Campaign 6 from 2nd-31st October, 2026
subtitle:
Ministries/Departments plan to make #SpecialCampaign6, the biggest Special Campaign so far. Targets for Swachhata campaigns and parameters for disposal of pendency entered on the Special Campaign 6 portal.
Under a new component of the Special Campaign, on a dedicated day and date, the Ministries/Departments to take campaign to the last mile covering their every office and establishment on a focussed campaign activity
#SpecialCampaign6 gaining traction on social media with large scale awareness generation and campaign advocacy driven through electronic, print and social media including 3,023 tweets, and 103 PIB statements
body_text:
The Special Campaign 6 launched by the Government, with Department of Administrative Reforms & Public Grievances as the nodal department, has gained significant momentum. The preparatory phase (16 th -30 th September, 2026) for the Special Campaign 6 completed on 30 th September, 2026 and Implementation Phase started from 2 nd October 2026.
As a new component added to Special Campaign 6, the identified Ministries/Department to dedicate one day of the campaign to a focused activity like Cleanliness Practices, Grievance Redressal, Enhancement and Efficient Management of Office Space, Plantation drive, etc. covering all their attached/subordinate offices/autonomous bodies/field units to ensure wider participation and magnify the impact of Special Campaign 6 across the country.
The following targets have been uploaded by Ministries/ Departments on the campaign portal as on 05.10.2026:
S No Parameters #Targets SC 6 1 Cleanliness Campaign Sites 12,45,073 2 References from MPs 4,880 3 Parliamentary Assurances 856 4 IMC References 92 5 State Govt. References 802 6 Public Grievances 6,18,516 7 Public Grievances Appeals 19,733 8 PMO References 1,933 9 Physical Files due for Review 19,52,472 10 eFiles put up for review 5,54,146 11 Easing of Rules 653 # Data reported by 80 Ministries/ Departments
The Special Campaign 6 has gained significant traction in social media with over 3,023 tweets and infographics by Ministries/Departments on #SpecialCampaign6 and issue of 103 PIB statements.
